abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.text: Restore 30% stamina and hunger at once. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Signal Flare
abilities.text: Fire a flare that lights the area and makes enemies within 24 blocks glow for 10 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Pounce
abilities.text: Leap 6 blocks forward; land without fall damage. 15 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Twitching Whiskers
abilities.text: Shows the hostile mobs within 20 blocks through walls for 8 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Dolphin's Grace
abilities.text: Dolphin's Grace for 30 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Rain Dance
abilities.text: Starts rain for 2 minutes. 30 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Web Shot
abilities.text: Shoot a web that holds the first enemy hit in place for 2 s. 12 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Egg Sac
abilities.text: Hatch two small spiders that fight for you for 20 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Field Forge
abilities.text: Repair the item in your hand by 15% of its durability. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Smelt
abilities.text: Smelt up to 8 ores in your hand at once. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Fletch
abilities.text: Make 8 arrows from nothing. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Elven Grace
abilities.text: No fall damage and Speed I for 20 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Snare Trap
abilities.text: Place a trap that roots the first enemy for 3 s. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Sneaky Git
abilities.text: Invisibility for 8 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Lure
abilities.text: Mobs within 10 blocks walk toward you for 3 s, not attacking. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Lullaby
abilities.text: Make yourself and the nearest player able to sleep at any time for 60 s. 20 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Heave
abilities.text: Pick up and throw the creature in front of you 5 blocks. 20 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Big Appetite
abilities.text: Eat a full meal at once: fill all hunger and saturation. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Burrow Dive
abilities.text: Dive into soft ground and pop up 8 blocks ahead. 20 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Gulp
abilities.text: Eat raw fish and meat for double food for 60 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Purifying Light
abilities.text: Clear all harmful effects from you and players within 6 blocks. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Blessing
abilities.text: Luck and Regeneration I for 30 s to you and a nearby player. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Talon Dive
abilities.text: Dive at the spot you look at; land with a 4-damage hit nearby. 20 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Feather Fall
abilities.text: Slow Falling for 30 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Swarm Call
abilities.text: Two rats fight for you for 15 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Hoard
abilities.text: Store 9 items in a hidden pocket you can open anywhere. Always on.

abilities.name: Shadow Pocket
abilities.text: Store your held item in the shadows and take it back anywhere. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Grasp
abilities.text: Shadow hands root the enemy you look at for 2 s. 15 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Spore Burst
abilities.text: Spores make enemies within 4 blocks cough (Slowness, Weakness) for 4 s. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Healing Spores
abilities.text: Players within 6 blocks get Regeneration I for 8 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Stone Shape
abilities.text: Raise a 3-block stone wall in front of you for 30 s. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Eat Stone
abilities.text: Eat a cobblestone block for 4 food. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Brimstone Meal
abilities.text: Eat charcoal or coal for 3 food. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.text: Breathe fire in a short cone for 3 s. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Grow Tree
abilities.text: Grow a sapling you look at into a tree at once. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Entangle
abilities.text: Roots hold enemies within 4 blocks for 2 s. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.text: Enemies within 8 blocks get Weakness I for 8 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Trophy
abilities.text: Your next kill drops its head or a bone. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Skitter
abilities.text: Speed II and step up full blocks for 8 s. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Pack Tactics
abilities.text: Allies within 8 blocks deal 10% more for 10 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Raise Servant
abilities.text: Raise a skeleton that fights for you for 30 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Lantern of Souls
abilities.text: A soul lantern light that follows you for 2 minutes. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Call Pack
abilities.text: Two wolves fight for you for 30 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Moon Sight
abilities.text: Night Vision for 2 minutes at night. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Decoy
abilities.text: Leave a copy of yourself that mobs chase for 4 s. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Hollow Form
abilities.text: Projectiles pass through you for 4 s. 90 s cooldown.
